sloka: तदा सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह ।सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः ॥२-१४-६२॥
transliteration: tadā sumantram mantrajñā kaikeyī pratyuvāca ha ।sumantra rājā rajanīṁ rāmaharṣasamutsukaḥ ॥2-14-62॥

translations.english: O Sumantra, excited with joy on account of the (proposed) installation of Rama, the king did not have a wink of sleep all night. He is weary and overpowered with sleep.
